findings.summary: The A4 acceptance tests never run. `class TestInvariants` is defined twice at module scope in the same test file; the second definition (pages/invariants unit tests) rebinds the name and silently discards the first class, which is the only home of test_inv1_no_mutating_fs_tools, test_inv2_id_server_issued, test_inv2_id_falsification_rejected and test_inv2_create_with_id_rejected. Spec §8 A4 (INV-1 list_tools assertion + INV-2 forged-id REF_MISMATCH) is therefore unverified by the suite despite appearing to be covered.

INV-5 ('任何 mutation 恰好产生一个 git commit 与一个 .katana/manifests/ 账本文件') is violated: manifest filenames are derived solely from a second-granularity timestamp (`%Y%m%dT%H%M%S.json`), so any two mutations within the same wall-clock second overwrite the same ledger file and the earlier manifest is lost. The A8 concurrency test performs five creates inside one second and the A1 test only asserts `len(manifests) >= 1`, so the loss is never detected. Acceptance A1 explicitly requires asserting the manifest count is exactly +1 per mutation.

Ingest-grade provenance contradicts the spec. §2 requires 'create 时正文须含 # References 节或 frontmatter sources 非空（二者其一）', but for non-code page types validate_page bypasses check_provenance and hard-requires frontmatter `sources`, emitting '缺 frontmatter sources（ingest 模式要求；# References 不够）'. A compliant 卡片/索引 page whose provenance is a `# References` section is rejected by wiki_create and wiki_ingest_apply.

INV-4 degradation is bypassed by test-double special-casing in production code. WikiSearch.__init__ isinstance-checks ErrorEmbeddingClient to pre-set keyword_only/last_error, and _embed_page returns early for that class before the try/except, so the page is never added to _degraded_pages. Acceptance A5 requires '抛错 embedder 下写入成功、该页 degraded、mode == keyword_only'; the degraded-page half of A5 is neither implemented nor asserted for the injected error embedder (the test only checks mode and last_error).

For a real (non-test-double) embedding client, _embed_page's failure handler records degraded_pages and last_error but never flips self._mode to 'keyword_only'. Write-path embedding failure therefore leaves index_health.mode reporting 'hybrid' while no vectors are being written — the exact silently-dead vector index that INV-4 exists to surface.

Spec §9 forbids silently swallowing exceptions ('所有 except 必须保留原始异常文本进日志或返回体'), yet scan_pages discards every per-page read/parse error with a bare `except Exception: pass`, and WikiSearch.rebuild swallows lancedb table-recreation failures the same way. No error text reaches a log or a response body.

INV-2 title uniqueness can be defeated by an unparseable page. find_page_by_title returns None when parse_page raises (malformed YAML frontmatter), so wiki_create's TITLE_EXISTS check misses that title and _write silently overwrites the existing bad page file instead of rejecting. INV-6 also requires that operations targeting a bad page error out rather than being treated as absent.

Acceptance A7's second half is not implemented: there is no test that opens the migrate output directly with the v2 server and smoke-tests `--rebuild-index` + `wiki_search` on it. The migration tests assert only file layout, link normalization, id preservation, exclusion and byte-idempotence.

Several acceptance assertions are weaker than spec §8 demands: A2 never asserts 'broken link 增量 = 0'; A3 never asserts the delete + inlink rewrite landed in the same commit; A8 asserts `commits >= 5 + 1` rather than exactly one commit per mutation with no cross-contamination. The invariants these criteria pin down are consequently unproven.

The lancedb vector column is hard-coded to a fixed_size_list of 512 while embedding `dim` is a configurable injection point, so any deployment or test using dim != 512 fails table creation/insertion and degrades to keyword_only with an opaque arrow error.

_mutate has no failure path: if write_fn raises after partially writing page files, the exception propagates with no rollback and no commit, leaving the data repo worktree dirty and breaking INV-5's 'git status --porcelain 在任意两次调用之间为空'. No test covers a mid-mutation failure.
